gbm_population_evidence.quote: Brain Cancer; Glioblastoma; Metastatic Cancer; Leptomeningeal Metastasis; Recurrent Glioblastoma
Cohort C: Participants with recurrent glioblastoma requiring neurosurgical resection/biopsy

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to find out how much tratuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) can penetrate the tumor when injected into the body, and whether T-DXd may be an effective treatment for brain cancers that express the HER2 protein.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To evaluate the brain tumor penetration of trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) and its payload (DXd) in Her2+/Her2-low/Her2-mutant brain metastases and of Her2-expressing glioblastoma.
Concentrations will be presented as brain tumor:plasma ratios across brain lesions, using intraoperative plasma concentrations

role_evidence.quote: All participants will receive T-DXd prior to indicated brain tumor resection/biopsy

agents.drug_class_hint: HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (topoisomerase I inhibitor payload DXd)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: HER2 (ERBB2) expression or activating ERBB2 mutation

source_quote.quote: Participants with Her2-expressing or solid tumors with activating ERBB2 mutations with 1 or more CNS metastases requiring neurosurgical resection/biopsy with no prior T-DXd

coder_notes: Window-of-opportunity trial in brain metastases (HER2-expressing/ERBB2-mutant, cohorts A and B) plus recurrent glioblastoma (cohort C); glioblastoma named in conditions, inclusion and arm label, so basket_gbm_eligible. HER2 is required only for the metastasis cohorts; the glioblastoma inclusion criterion has no HER2 requirement, although the brief summary and primary outcome refer to 'Her2-expressing glioblastoma'. HER2 is the target of T-DXd, so matched. Treatment setting: recurrent GBM cohort plus metastatic cancer (advanced) = recurrent. Three experimental cohorts, none a control, so control_arm_from_other_arms = no.
